pyq_bad.why: garbled: OCR junk in stem and option 3 repeats a statement

patterns: APPSC asks regulator basics as single facts or 2-statement items: TRAI year (1997), CCI statutory under Competition Act 2002 amended 2007 (composition-number statements are traps).
Act-year matching (Essential Commodities 1955, AGMARK 1937, PFA 1954, FSS Act 2006) is a recurring APPSC-G2 shape.
FSSAI facts surface via current affairs (packaging rules 2019) and ministry traps (not under DGHS).
App MCQs cover appeals (TDSAT, NCLAT, APTEL), DPBI and CCI digital cases in more depth than PYQs; facts are sound.
